target.queryText:
SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
  AND i.symbol = '$symbol'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Trend - $symbol

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT trend AS "Trend"
FROM (
  SELECT session_date,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(close) OVER w20 < 20 THEN NULL
              WHEN close > AVG(close) OVER w20 AND AVG(close) OVER w5 > AVG(close) OVER w20 THEN 2
              WHEN close < AVG(close) OVER w20 AND AVG(close) OVER w5 < AVG(close) OVER w20 THEN 0
              ELSE 1 END AS trend
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  WINDOW w5  AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
         w20 AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
WHERE trend IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description:
Where price sits against its own averages. A description, not a forecast.

- **Bullish** — close and the 5-day average both above the 20-day average.
- **Bearish** — both below.
- **Neutral** — anything else.

panels.title: RSI (14) - $symbol

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ROUND(rsi14, 1) AS "RSI(14)"
FROM (
  SELECT session_date, ts_epoch,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(gain) OVER w14 < 14 THEN NULL
              WHEN AVG(loss) OVER w14 = 0 THEN 100.0
              ELSE 100.0 - 100.0 / (1 + (AVG(gain) OVER w14) / (AVG(loss) OVER w14))
         END AS rsi14
  FROM (
    SELECT session_date, ts_epoch,
           MAX(close - LAG(close) OVER p, 0) AS gain,
           MAX(LAG(close) OVER p - close, 0) AS loss
    FROM daily_bar
    WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
    WINDOW p AS (ORDER BY session_date))
  WINDOW w14 AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
WHERE rsi14 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description:
Momentum on a 0–100 scale, over the last 14 sessions.

- **RSI** — how hard price has been pushed one way. Above 70 is conventionally overbought (ran up fast, may pause); below 30 oversold (dropped fast, may bounce).

Simple-average (Cutler) RSI, not Wilder's smoothing: the same arithmetic as the Watchlist's.

panels.title: Beta - $symbol

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH market AS (
  SELECT session_date, LAG(session_date) OVER p AS previous,
         (close - LAG(close) OVER p) / LAG(close) OVER p AS change
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument
                         WHERE symbol = (SELECT market_symbol FROM canslim_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1))
  WINDOW p AS (ORDER BY session_date)),
stock AS (
  SELECT session_date, LAG(session_date) OVER p AS previous,
         (close - LAG(close) OVER p) / LAG(close) OVER p AS change
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  WINDOW p AS (ORDER BY session_date)),
paired AS (
  SELECT s.change AS s, m.change AS m
  FROM stock s JOIN market m ON m.session_date = s.session_date AND m.previous = s.previous
  WHERE s.change IS NOT NULL AND m.change IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.session_date DESC LIMIT 252)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 60 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*) * SUM(s * m) - SUM(s) * SUM(m))
                       / NULLIF(COUNT(*) * SUM(m * m) - SUM(m) * SUM(m), 0), 2) END AS "Beta"
FROM paired

panels.description:
How much this stock moves with the market.

- **Beta** — 1.0 moves with the market, above 1.0 amplifies it, below 1.0 damps it.

Measured against the market CAN SLIM reads (NIFTYBEES, a NIFTY 50 fund), over the last year of daily changes, 252 sessions at most, on days both traded. So it is comparable with a published NIFTY beta. Blank until there are 60 such days.

panels.title: $symbol - daily candles and moving averages

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT session_date, open, high, low, close, volume,
         LAG(close) OVER (ORDER BY session_date) AS previous_close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY session_date) AS n,
         MIN(session_date) OVER () AS first_day,
         MIN(date(session_date, '-3 months'), date(session_date, 'start of month', '-2 months', '-1 day')) AS quarter_from,
         MIN(date(session_date, '-12 months'), date(session_date, 'start of month', '-11 months', '-1 day')) AS year_from,
         MAX(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 30 FOLLOWING) AS nearby_max,
         SUM(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS volume50,
         COUNT(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sessions50
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
),
standing AS (
  SELECT d.n,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume IS NOT NULL) AS last20,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier20,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter20,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.quarter_from AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier_quarter,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.quarter_from AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter_quarter,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.year_from AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier_year,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.year_from AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter_year
  FROM sessions d
  JOIN sessions o ON o.n <= d.n AND (o.n > d.n - 20 OR o.session_date > d.year_from)
  GROUP BY d.n
),
day_facts AS (
  SELECT s.*, t.last20, t.heavier20, t.lighter20,
         CASE
           WHEN s.volume IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.year_from AND t.heavier_year = 0 THEN 'year high'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.year_from AND t.lighter_year = 0 THEN 'year low'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.quarter_from AND t.heavier_quarter = 0 THEN 'quarter high'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.quarter_from AND t.lighter_quarter = 0 THEN 'quarter low'
         END AS extreme,
         s.close > s.previous_close
           AND ROUND(100.0 * (s.high - s.low) / s.previous_close, 6) >= 5
           AND ROUND(3 * (s.close - s.low) - 2 * (s.high - s.low), 6) >= 0
           AND s.sessions50 = 50 AND 50 * s.volume >= 3 * s.volume50 AS bull_snort
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN standing t ON t.n = s.n
),
volume_kind AS (
  SELECT session_date, extreme,
         CASE
           WHEN volume IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN bull_snort THEN 'bull snort'
           WHEN extreme IS NOT NULL THEN extreme
           WHEN last20 = 20 AND heavier20 <= 1 THEN 'heavy'
           WHEN last20 = 20 AND lighter20 <= 1 THEN 'light'
           WHEN close < COALESCE(previous_close, open) THEN 'down'
           ELSE 'up'
         END AS kind,
         volume + 0.15 * nearby_max AS marker_at,
         CASE WHEN volume > 1000000 AND ROUND(100.0 * (close - previous_close) / previous_close, 6) >= 4.95
              THEN volume + 0.07 * nearby_max END AS glow_at
  FROM day_facts
)
SELECT b.ts_epoch AS time,
       b.open, b.high, b.low, b.close,
       b.volume,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(b.close) OVER w5  < 5  THEN NULL ELSE AVG(b.close) OVER w5  END AS "SMA 5",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(b.close) OVER w20 < 20 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(b.close) OVER w20 END AS "SMA 20",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(b.close) OVER w50 < 50 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(b.close) OVER w50 END AS "SMA 50",
       k.glow_at AS "Over 1 million shares, up 4.95% or more",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'down' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume, price down",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'up' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume, price up",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'heavy' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume ≥ 90th percentile of 20 sessions",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'light' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume ≤ 10th percentile of 20 sessions",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'bull snort' THEN b.volume END AS "Bull snort (range ≥ 5%, top-third close, up, 3× volume)",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'quarter high' THEN b.volume END AS "Highest volume in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'quarter low' THEN b.volume END AS "Lowest volume in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'year high' THEN b.volume END AS "Highest volume in 12 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'year low' THEN b.volume END AS "Lowest volume in 12 months",
       CASE WHEN k.extreme IN ('quarter high', 'quarter low') THEN k.marker_at END AS "Q · highest or lowest in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.extreme IN ('year high', 'year low') THEN k.marker_at END AS "Y · highest or lowest in 12 months"
FROM daily_bar b
JOIN volume_kind k ON k.session_date = b.session_date
WHERE b.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
WINDOW w5  AS (ORDER BY b.session_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
       w20 AS (ORDER BY b.session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
       w50 AS (ORDER BY b.session_date ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY b.session_date

Momentum over time, so you can see it building or fading rather than only today's reading.

The dashed lines mark 30 and 70.

panels.title: Market breadth - how much of the universe rose
panels.description:
Not symbol specific — the whole tracked universe.

- **Breadth** — share of tracked symbols that closed up. 50% is the line between a broad advance and a broad decline.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_epoch AS time,
       advancing_pct   AS "Advancing %",
       mean_change_pct AS "Mean change %"

panels.title: $symbol - supports and resistances
panels.description:
Levels price has had to get through, plotted against the close.

- **Pivot, R1/R2, S1/S2** — classic floor-trader pivots, computed from the previous session's high, low and close. R levels sit above as resistance, S levels below as support.
- **20-day high / low** — the rolling extremes price has actually traded through, once there are twenty sessions.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_epoch AS time,
       close                          AS "Close",
       pivot + (prev_high - prev_low) AS "R2",
       2 * pivot - prev_low           AS "R1",
       pivot                          AS "Pivot",
       2 * pivot - prev_high          AS "S1",
       pivot - (prev_high - prev_low) AS "S2",
       high_20 AS "20-day high", low_20 AS "20-day low"
FROM (
  SELECT session_date, ts_epoch, close,
         (LAG(high) OVER p + LAG(low) OVER p + LAG(close) OVER p) / 3.0 AS pivot,
         LAG(high) OVER p AS prev_high,
         LAG(low)  OVER p AS prev_low,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER w20 < 20 THEN NULL ELSE MAX(high) OVER w20 END AS high_20,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER w20 < 20 THEN NULL ELSE MIN(low)  OVER w20 END AS low_20
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  WINDOW p   AS (ORDER BY session_date),
         w20 AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
ORDER BY session_date

panels.title: $symbol - where price sits in its own range
panels.description:
Where the close sits between the low and high of a range: 0 is the bottom, 100 the top.

- **% of 10-day range** — where a stock sits this fortnight.
- **% of 52-week range** — where it sits over the past year: the last 252 sessions, the year CAN SLIM measures the distance from the high over. The closest thing to a valuation read here: dear or cheap against its own history, not against its earnings.

Both roll with every session, and each starts once its window is full: a stock with less than a year of daily bars has no 52-week line yet.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_epoch AS time,
       CASE WHEN sessions_252 < 252 OR high_252 <= low_252 THEN NULL
            ELSE (close - low_252) / (high_252 - low_252) * 100.0 END AS "% of 52-week range",
       CASE WHEN sessions_10 < 10 OR high_10 <= low_10 THEN NULL
            ELSE (close - low_10) / (high_10 - low_10) * 100.0 END    AS "% of 10-day range"
FROM (
  SELECT session_date, ts_epoch, close,
         COUNT(*)  OVER w10  AS sessions_10,
         MAX(high) OVER w10  AS high_10,
         MIN(low)  OVER w10  AS low_10,
         COUNT(*)  OVER w252 AS sessions_252,
         MAX(high) OVER w252 AS high_252,
         MIN(low)  OVER w252 AS low_252
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  WINDOW w10  AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
         w252 AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 251 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
ORDER BY session_date

panels.title: $symbol - liquidity screen
panels.description: The liquidity screen from the slide, for this stock: a close above ₹25 and at most ₹10,000, a market cap of at least ₹300 crore (from its screener.in page, once read), and at least ₹5 crore traded on the latest session (close × volume). Then its turnover, the average volume over the last 20 sessions times their average close, against your largest position: it should be 10 to 20 times that, so a position can be taken and left without moving the price. The largest position is the amount in the box at the top of the page, or, left blank, your largest buy order of the last 90 days in the journal (an order's fills together, across the accounts).

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT session_date, close, volume
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  ORDER BY session_date DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
latest AS (SELECT close, volume FROM recent ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1),
turnover AS (SELECT AVG(volume) * AVG(close) AS rupees, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM recent),
cap AS (SELECT MAX(market_cap_cr) AS crore FROM company_profile WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')),
largest AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM('$max_position'), '') AS REAL),
                  (SELECT MAX(value) FROM (
                     SELECT SUM(t.quantity * t.price) AS value
                     FROM trade t
                     WHERE t.side = 'BUY' AND t.session_date >= date('now', '-90 days')
                     GROUP BY t.profile, t.session_date, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts)))) AS rupees
)
SELECT 1 AS position, 'Close above ₹25' AS "Screen", printf('₹%,.2f', l.close) AS "Value",
       CASE WHEN l.close > 25 THEN 'Passes' ELSE 'Fails' END AS "Result"
FROM latest l
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'Close at most ₹10,000', printf('₹%,.2f', l.close),
       CASE WHEN l.close <= 10000 THEN 'Passes' ELSE 'Fails' END
FROM latest l
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'Market cap at least ₹300 crore',
       CASE WHEN c.crore IS NULL THEN 'not read yet' ELSE printf('₹%,d crore', CAST(ROUND(c.crore) AS INTEGER)) END,
       CASE WHEN c.crore IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN c.crore >= 300 THEN 'Passes' ELSE 'Fails' END
FROM cap c
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'Value traded on the latest session at least ₹5 crore', printf('₹%,.2f crore', l.close * l.volume / 1e7),
       CASE WHEN l.close * l.volume >= 5e7 THEN 'Passes' ELSE 'Fails' END
FROM latest l
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'Turnover (20-day average volume × average close) 10 to 20× your largest position',
       printf('₹%,.2f crore', t.rupees / 1e7)
         || CASE WHEN g.rupees > 0 THEN printf(', %.1f× ₹%,d', t.rupees / g.rupees, CAST(ROUND(g.rupees) AS INTEGER))
                 ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN g.rupees IS NULL OR g.rupees <= 0 THEN 'Unknown'
            WHEN t.rupees >= 20 * g.rupees THEN 'Passes, 20×'
            WHEN t.rupees >= 10 * g.rupees THEN 'Passes, 10×'
            ELSE 'Fails' END
FROM turnover t CROSS JOIN largest g
WHERE t.sessions > 0
ORDER BY position

panels.title: $symbol - value traded and turnover (₹ crore)
panels.description: The value traded each session (close × volume) as bars; the turnover, the average volume over 20 sessions times their average close, as a line; the screen's ₹5 crore; and 10 and 20 times your largest position (the box at the top of the page, or your largest buy order of the last 90 days). The turnover line should stay above the 10× line, better the 20×.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH bars AS (
  SELECT session_date, ts_epoch, close, volume,
         AVG(volume) OVER twenty AS avg_volume, AVG(close) OVER twenty AS avg_close, COUNT(*) OVER twenty AS sessions
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
  WINDOW twenty AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
largest AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM('$max_position'), '') AS REAL),
                  (SELECT MAX(value) FROM (
                     SELECT SUM(t.quantity * t.price) AS value
                     FROM trade t
                     WHERE t.side = 'BUY' AND t.session_date >= date('now', '-90 days')
                     GROUP BY t.profile, t.session_date, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts)))) AS rupees
)
SELECT b.ts_epoch AS time,
       ROUND(b.close * b.volume / 1e7, 2) AS "Value traded, ₹ crore",
       CASE WHEN b.sessions = 20 THEN ROUND(b.avg_volume * b.avg_close / 1e7, 2) END
         AS "Turnover: 20-day average volume × average close",
       5 AS "Screen: ₹5 crore",
       ROUND(10 * g.rupees / 1e7, 2) AS "10× your largest position",
       ROUND(20 * g.rupees / 1e7, 2) AS "20× your largest position"
FROM bars b
CROSS JOIN largest g
ORDER BY b.session_date
